description: This Java source file defines the Spring Boot configuration class 'Config' for the Hono LoRa adapter, including bean definitions, configuration validation, and metrics setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the LoRa adapter, managing bean creation, configuration validation, and metrics.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the LoRa Protocol Adapter is configured to require authentication; throws exception if not.

methods.name: loraProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of LoraProtocolAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name of the downstream sender factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name of the registration client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name of the credentials client factory if not already set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets the name of the tenant client factory if not already set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the LoRa adapter, mapped from 'hono.lora' prefix.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing LoRa protocol adapter instances.

methods.name: cacheManager
methods.description: Provides a cache manager bean using ConcurrentMapCacheManager.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures metrics registry with common tags for the LoRa protocol adapter.
